decision_note: J&T Banka-backed early-stage VC with its office in Prague (EUR 120m AUM, pre-seed to Series A, CEE/SEE/Baltics); joined Supernova's Series A (Sep 2025) and ValkaAI's pre-seed (Feb 2026) and led Definic's seed (Jun 2026).

evidence.quote: Investiční kolo vedl český fond J&T Ventures, ke kterému se připojil Seed Starter patřící pod Českou spořitelnu a Slovak Investment Holding.
Startup v pre-seedovém kole získal rekordní investici 12 milionů eur, tedy necelých 300 milionů korun, a to od tuzemských fondů J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures, BD Partners
do kola se připojily i fondy J&T Ventures, Reflex Capital, Kaya, Credo Ventures, EQT Ventures, Wing VC a Y Combinator

analyst_notes: Office: the investor's site gives the address J&T Ventures, budova J&T Banka, Sokolovská 700/113a, Praha 8 (all fund vehicles are Czech, registered at the same address); CzechCrunch calls it a Czech fund. The brand originated in the J&T group (Czech-Slovak) - check for overlap with the Slovak reference set. Corporate flag set because the funds are sponsored by the J&T Banka group (site sits in the J&T Banka building); this is an analyst judgement. Focus/stage/ticket/region/AUM are labels from the homepage blocks: 'Sector Agnostic', 'Pre-seed až Series A', '€300K – €3M' (Velikost investice), region 'CEE & SEE & Baltics', '€120M' (Výše aktiv = assets) - the page is undated (footer © 2024), so capital.as_of is left empty. Fund vehicles: J&T VENTURES I OPF (2014), J&T Ventures CG SICAV with sub-fund J&T Ventures II (2019), J&T Ventures III SICAV a.s. (registered 2024-10-21; no dated size announcement found); the SICAVs' statutory body is the white-label manager AMISTA investiční společnost. The investment-team company was not identified in ARES. Round amounts are whole rounds; ValkaAI's EUR 12m pre-seed was led by Rockaway Ventures; Definic seed led by J&T Ventures. Web search budget was exhausted during this research, so no further sources (e.g. fund III size) were checked.
